description: Tallyhand is an open-source contractor workspace for time tracking, invoicing, expenses, and project management. It offers hosted cloud access plus local/offline and self-hosted deployment options.
summary: tallyhand.xyz exposes three developer integration surfaces: a REST API at `https://tallyhand.xyz/api/v1`, a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://tallyhand.xyz/api/mcp`, and the `tally` CLI; auth is via personal API key, with OAuth 2.0 also supported for REST and MCP.
